name: writeClipboard
description: Put plain text on the OS clipboard from the browser process, for a mod's $.ui.copy (F-25). Unlike the page's navigator.clipboard it needs neither the document's focus nor a user gesture, so it is the first path a copy takes. The text is read back after the write; a clipboard that did not take it (another process holding it) answers UI_ERROR, and the guest falls back to the page's clipboard paths.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: The text to copy, as the mod asked (after any ui.copy hook rewrote it).
